report.title: Accelerate
report.quote: If you would like to apply for support through our Accelerate programme, please fill out our simple online expression of interest form.
report.note: Programme page and the get-support page both carry an always-available EOI form and no dates anywhere. An open form is not a statement that applications are accepted at any time.

report.title: Achievement Award Scheme
report.quote: Each year, we recognise circa 12,000 Achievement Award winners and invest £3.5m through the Achievement Award scheme.
report.note: Organisations join the scheme rather than apply to a round. Closest the page comes to timing is the annual volume.

report.title: Alan Higgs Community Grants
report.quote: Please read the Fund Factsheet and our Essential Information before applying.
report.note: The fund page has no dates and no rounds. Any timing is in the linked factsheet.

report.title: Annandale and Nithsdale Community Benefit Company
report.quote: Application deadline: 03/09/26
report.note: Three rounds listed for 2026 (05/01, 02/04, 03/09); the last passed three days ago and no 2027 date is published. The dates move year to year, so there is no cycle to roll forward.

report.title: Arts Council of Northern Ireland — Lottery Grants
report.quote: Our Funding Programmes are open to individuals and to organisations. Each funding programme is different, and each programme has useful guidance notes on who can apply, and what you can apply for.
report.note: apply_url is the funding index. It states no dates and does not name a single scheme this row could be, so nothing is followed.

report.title: Arts Council of Wales — Have a Go
report.quote: We recommend that you register at least 5 working days before you wish to start your application.
report.note: Unlike its sibling funds, this page states neither a deadline nor that there is none. The registration lead time is the only timing on it.

report.title: ASTOP — Rent-Free Property for Charities
report.quote: Whether you’re a landlord with empty space or a charitable organization seeking a home, we invite you to explore how ASTOP can help you make a positive impact on your community.
report.note: A matching service with a contact form, no application window stated.

report.title: Aurora Trust
report.quote: The Aurora Trust does not generally accept unsolicited applications.
report.note: Reported rather than written: whether the row belongs live is a separate question from timing.

report.title: B&Q Foundation — Home Improvement & Home-Starter Kits Funds
report.quote: Please note that due to the high volume of applications, it may take up to 12 weeks after the deadline to hear the outcome.
report.note: The page implies a deadline without stating one. Both application links go to Neighbourly campaign pages (HomeImprovementGrants2026, BQHomeStarterKits26) which render nothing without JavaScript.

report.title: Bairdwatson Charitable Trust
report.quote: Applications close: 07/08/26
report.note: Opened 03/07/26, closed 07/08/26, decisions end of December 2026. No next round published.

report.quote: Loading content...

report.title: Bedfordshire & Luton Community Foundation — Community Grants
report.quote: You can find all our funds in the grants section on our website. Each has its own criteria document and application form.
report.note: Funder-level row over roughly a dozen named funds on separate timetables. The apply page states no date for any of them.

report.title: Black Founders Programme
report.quote: If you are interested in updates and news about the Black Founders Programme, fill out the short form below.
report.note: An accelerator that runs in cohorts; the page describes the 2025 cohort and offers a mailing list, and names no application window.

report.title: Buttle UK — Chances for Children Grants
report.quote: Make sure to submit your application only when you have time to speak with us.
report.note: Criteria page, grants page and FAQs all say when in a child's circumstances to apply and never when in the year.

report.title: Calouste Gulbenkian Foundation UK Branch — Grants
report.quote: The UK Branch aims to strengthen arts and civil society ecosystems by supporting transnational exchange, reciprocal capacity development and knowledge sharing between Portugal and the UK.
report.note: The page carries no sentence about timing at all, so the quote is the closest thing to one: what the branch funds, with no word on when. Last updated 18 December 2025.

report.title: Camden Climate Fund
report.quote: Just a moment...
report.note: HTTP 403 behind a Cloudflare interstitial.

report.title: Camden Council - Family-Friendly and Inclusive Evenings Grant Scheme
report.quote: Just a moment...
report.note: HTTP 403 behind a Cloudflare interstitial. Same host as the Camden Climate Fund row; both need a browser.

report.title: Cash for Kids - Cost of Living Grants
report.quote: As our ability to grant depends on the donations we receive, application forms will close when we reach capacity – so may not be available for all areas at all times.
report.note: Neither dated nor rolling: forms open and shut by area as money allows, and the page will not say when for any of them.

report.title: Charity Digital Exchange — Software Donations
report.quote: Please log in or Register to access these exclusive discounts.
report.note: A login-walled catalogue of donated software rather than a round. No window stated on the public side.

report.title: Charity Digital Skills Programme
report.quote: Your destination for trusted technology, exclusive discounts and great deals. Keep up with our latest offers by signing up here.
report.note: apply_url is the site home page. It carries webinar and event dates, none of which is an application window for this row.

report.title: Charity IT Association (CITA) — Tech Volunteers
report.quote: CITA provides charities with access to affordable, trustworthy, and independent technology professionals to enable their strategic mission through technology.
report.note: A volunteer-matching service with no round and no stated window.

report.title: City & Guilds Foundation — Local Community Skills Fund
report.quote: Expressions of Interest are currently closed. Sign up to our newsletter to hear about future rounds.
report.note: The page also says "We aim to open our community grants programme at regular intervals throughout the year", which is an intention rather than a date, so nothing is written.

report.title: Civitates — Pooled Fund for European Democracy
report.quote: Sign up for news, updates from our grantee partners and calls for proposals.
report.note: Grants go out in calls for proposals; no call is open on the site and no next one is dated.
